```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  check-ai-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Download check script
        run: |
          mkdir -p .github/scripts
          curl -o .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh \
            https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/main/.github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
          chmod +x .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

      - name: Run AI co-author check
        id: check
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          OUTPUT=$(.github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh)
          if [ -n "$OUTPUT" ]; then
            echo "AI co-authors found:"
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            echo "failure=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "No AI co-authors found."
            echo "failure=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Fail if AI co-authors found
        if: steps.check.outputs.failure == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "❌ AI co-authors detected in commit trailers."
          echo "Please remove AI co-authors from your commits before merging."
          echo ""
          echo "To fix this:"
          echo "1. Rebase your branch to remove the problematic commits"
          echo "2. Use 'git rebase -i' to edit the commit messages"
          echo "3. Remove any lines containing AI co-authors like:"
          echo "   Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>"
          echo "   Co-authored-by: Copilot <copilot@github.com>"
          echo ""
          echo "Example command to rebase:"
          echo "git rebase -i --root"
          exit 1
```
